finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code opens a specific device file '/dev/ttyS0' which is not attacker-controlled. There is no user input or attacker-controlled data involved in this operation.

parsed.refutation_attempt: No untrusted data source feeds into the open call; the path argument is a compile‑time string literal and cannot be influenced by an attacker. The code contains no user input, environment variables, or network data that could reach line 1. Therefore, there is no path from an attacker‑controlled source to the sink, and no trigger exists.
